title: Hospital admissions
goal: Define admissions responsibilities for patients, registrars, and an insurer.

rubric.must: Hospital Admission System is visibly drawn as a subject boundary around admission use cases.
Register Patient has dashed «include» arrows pointing to Record Demographics, Verify Coverage, and Create Admission.
Verify Coverage is associated with the external-system actor Insurance Clearinghouse.
Escalate Emergency extends Perform Triage toward the named emergency escalation extension point.
Emergency Patient generalizes to Patient with a hollow triangle.
